paragraphs.text: Gimbal is a gremlin artificer from Avishkar who fought in defense of the plane.

As a wee gremlin on Kaladesh, Gimbal and his twenty-three siblings survived on nothing but the rustiest scraps of metal they could get their mouths on. It might have been a short life too, after he fell into the Aether Reservoir, but when he awoke, he found something miraculous had happened: his formerly one-track mind had more neurons firing than light displays at the Inventors' Fair. People soon began to notice tools and raw materials mysteriously vanishing, and it wasn't long before the gremlin's ingenuity became widely known. Impressed by his innovative genius, they brought him in to work on Project Golden Scale, a large-scale construction of dinosaur-inspired combat vehicles, in preparation for the incoming Phyrexian invasion. It was also at this time that the gremlin was given the name "Gimbal." Gimbal played a crucial role in enhancing the deadliness of the project's aether cannons, aether blasters, aether blades, and, of course, aether bombs. But humans have short memories, and who knows how long they'll continue to sing his praises after the invasion ends? Fortunately, Gimbal's been making his own plans to ensure the future of gremlinkind.
